items.title: Ground Stop Highlights Chronic Vulnerabilities in Air Traffic System
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration’s aging air traffic control infrastructure has had several disruptive failures in recent months, as officials have sought to make upgrades.

items.title: Trump Kept Out of Sight as F.A.A. Issued Flight Ground Stop
items.summary: The F.A.A. called a rare halt on flights nationwide, but the president stayed away from cameras and issued social media posts on the entertainment industry and California’s Democratic governor.

items.title: What to Know About Continued Flight Disruptions
items.summary: After a nationwide ground stop Friday, travelers are still encountering snags, and it could take several days for flight schedules to return to normal.

items.title: After Relative Silence, Joe Rogan Said MAGA Has Lost the “Podcast Bros”
items.summary: The nation’s top podcaster addressed the midterm election results, days after declaring that he thinks politics is “gross.”

items.title: Perhaps the Rumors of Democracy’s Demise Were Premature
items.summary: Did the midterm election save it?

items.title: Jensen Huang Carried a Secret for More Than a Year. It Led to His Downfall.
items.summary: Nvidia’s leader said his relationship with a female customer was just about business. But what he was concealing eventually led to his resignation from the company he created.

items.title: Tech Leaders Rally Behind Jensen Huang
items.summary: In social media posts and letters to Nvidia’s board, Mr. Huang’s billionaire peers described him as a singular leader who could not be replaced at Nvidia.

items.title: Judge Blocks Immediate Closure of East Potomac Park for Trump Golf Project
items.summary: Judge Ana C. Reyes, who has been overseeing combative litigation, said the Trump administration would not be responsible for operating the course while the case proceeded.

items.title: Key Witness in Comey Case Attests to Justice Dept.’s Aggressive Tactics
items.summary: A former aide to James Comey at the F.B.I. said the government had engaged in a “harassment campaign” in its efforts to secure witness testimony.

items.title: When Disaster Hit Next Door in Flatbush
items.summary: What it felt like when the wall came down in Brooklyn.

items.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
items.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

items.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
items.summary: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

items.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
items.summary: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

items.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

items.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
items.summary: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

items.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
items.summary: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

items.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
items.summary: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

items.title: 'We can't let them down' -- After midterm wins, Democrats turn to charting path ahead
items.summary: Democrats from across the country descended on Denver for a two-day conference to chart the course of their party after sweeping victories in the midterm elections.

items.title: FAA blames Friday's ground stop on 'equipment issue' during telecoms network upgrade
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said initial investigations pointed to an issue with contractor L3Harris updating old tech at a remote location.

items.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
items.summary: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.

items.title: FAA was warned for years about repair risks leading to nationwide ground stop
items.summary: Officials said installation of a new router was behind the cancellation of more than 12,000 flights.

items.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick’s Day event, citing DeSantis’s anti-DEI law
items.summary: Gov. Ron DeSantis called it a ‘stunt,’ insisting Delray Beach is misinterpreting the Florida law.

items.title: Detroit to retrain bus drivers after two horses board city bus
items.summary: Jordan Williams, an urban cowboy, said he had decided to board the bus and take a video to highlight “there are cowboys that look like us.”

items.title: Work to replace old wiring led to ground stop, transportation secretary says
items.summary: Thousands of flights were canceled Saturday, a day after the nationwide outage. The FAA said flights should be back on schedule by the end of the weekend.

items.title: FBI investigates powerful bomb found at Illinois ethanol plant
items.summary: Dozens of people within a mile of the facility in Peoria were evacuated, and hours later law enforcement officers were still extensively searching the building.

items.title: Chris Van Hollen revs up his public campaign to replace Chuck Schumer
items.summary: The Democratic senator from Maryland launched a website and will hit the Sunday shows.

items.title: California’s battered beaches are getting giant waves
items.summary: Mavericks Beach, a famed big-wave surf spot, may get up to 50-foot waves.

items.title: What are your rights when your flight is canceled?
items.summary: Federal rules don’t provide many avenues to alleviate your misery, unfortunately, but individual airlines have made some voluntary commitments.

items.title: Duffy’s news briefing on nationwide ground stop disrupted by tech difficulties
items.summary: A Transportation Department news briefing Saturday morning about the nationwide ground stop a day earlier was derailed by tech issues. “This is our kind of, um, day,” Sean Duffy said.

items.title: White evangelicals voted less, and less for the GOP, new analysis says
items.summary: In 343 counties dubbed evangelical hubs, turnout was 66 percent of what it was in 2024, according to a new analysis.
